rounds.title: Round 7
rounds.prompt: Name a traditional American Thanksgiving dish that tastes way better when you add Indian spices or chutneys.

rounds.title: Round 8
rounds.prompt: Name something an Indian parent or auntie says the second you walk through the door.

rounds.title: Round 9
rounds.prompt: Name something inside an Indian auntie's purse or Tupperware stash at party's end.

rounds.title: Round 10
rounds.prompt: Name a classic excuse an Indian relative gives when grabbing the restaurant check.

answers.text: "I already gave my card to the waiter"
"You pay next time we visit you"
"Put your wallet away or I'm leaving!"

rounds.title: Round 11
rounds.prompt: Name something that happens during the "Indian Goodbye" when guests finally say they are leaving.

answers.text: Talking by the front door for 45 mins
Host forcing leftover Tupperware on you
"One more cup of chai before you drive!"
Taking 15 group photos on the porch
Standing by open car door talking

rounds.title: Round 12
rounds.prompt: Name the most creative way a Desi family uses up leftover Thanksgiving turkey.

answers.text: Giving it away in yogurt tubs

rounds.title: Round 13 (Kids Guess)
rounds.prompt: Name a classic phrase an Indian parent says when you ask for a sleepover.

answers.text: "Who all is going? / Do I know their parents?"
"Why sleep there? You have a bed at home!"

rounds.title: Round 14 (Parents Guess)
rounds.prompt: Name something a teen/college kid says to avoid talking about grades or internships.

answers.text: "I don't know yet / Still figuring it out"
"I have to go study / have a call"

rounds.title: Round 15 (Kids Guess)
rounds.prompt: Name something an Indian parent does right after buying a new gadget or car.

answers.text: Leave the protective plastic film on forever
Put a heavy-duty case / seat cover on it
Compare price to how cheap it was at Costco
Keep the cardboard box in the garage
Ask kids how to set up the Wi-Fi

rounds.title: Round 16 (Parents Guess)
rounds.prompt: Name something kids spend too much money on that drives Indian parents crazy.

answers.text: Uber / Lyft instead of walking or train

rounds.title: Round 17 (Kids Guess)
rounds.prompt: Name something an Indian parent refuses to pay full price for.

answers.text: Shipping fees ("I'll pick it up at store")

rounds.title: Round 18 (Parents Guess)
rounds.prompt: Name a slang word kids use today that leaves parents completely confused.

rounds.title: Round 19
rounds.prompt: Name what an Indian parent says when you have a headache or cold.

answers.text: "Drink hot water / ginger chai / haldi doodh"
"Put Vicks VapoRub / Tiger Balm on it"
"Went outside with wet hair / no jacket"

rounds.title: Round 20
rounds.prompt: Name something you see in a family WhatsApp group every morning.

answers.text: Blurry vacation photos from an uncle

rounds.title: Round 21
rounds.prompt: Name something in EVERY Indian spice box (masala dabba).

rounds.title: Round 22
rounds.prompt: Name a classic excuse an Indian kid gives to skip a family party.

answers.text: "I won't know anyone my age there!"

rounds.title: Round 23
rounds.prompt: Name something an Indian dad insists on doing himself.

answers.text: Mowing the lawn / Washing the car

rounds.title: Round 24
rounds.prompt: Name something an Indian parent considers a "waste of money."

answers.text: Eating out ("We have food at home!")
Valet parking or airport seat selection

rounds.title: Round 25
rounds.prompt: Name something guaranteed on the dance floor at an Indian wedding.

answers.text: Aunties forming a tight circle pulling people in
Throwing fake cash / dollar bills in the air
Kids sliding across the floor on knees
Losing a safety pin, dupatta, or shoe

rounds.title: Round 26
rounds.prompt: Name a song that packs the dance floor at any Desi party.

rounds.title: Round 27
rounds.prompt: Name something that always happens when the whole family tries to take ONE nice Thanksgiving group photo.

answers.text: Mom/Auntie fixing someone's hair or collar

rounds.title: Round 28
rounds.prompt: Name something that goes wrong right before a big Indian party starts.

answers.text: Blouse, kurta, or zipper breaks last minute
Caterer or biryani tray is 1 hour late
Fighting over the bathroom / iron / curling iron
Mom stressed yelling to clean living room

rounds.title: Round 29
rounds.prompt: Name something you MUST pack in your suitcase when flying back from India to the US.

rounds.title: Round 30
rounds.prompt: Name a way you can immediately tell an Indian family is at the airport.

answers.text: Suitcases wrapped in plastic or bright ribbons
Repacking overweight bags on floor at check-in
Carrying homemade parathas / thepla in foil

rounds.title: Round 31
rounds.prompt: Name a career path that makes Indian parents beam with pride when bragging to relatives.

rounds.title: Round 32
rounds.prompt: Name a topic that starts a 45-minute debate among uncles after chai.

answers.text: Real estate / Interest rates / Stock market
Whose kids got into which college / job
Traffic / Which route has fewer tolls

rounds.title: Round 33
rounds.prompt: Name a classic trope or scene you see in almost every old-school Bollywood movie.

answers.text: Choreographed dance in the rain or Swiss Alps
Rich parents forbidding marriage to someone poor
One punch sending 10 bad guys flying in slow-mo
Dramatic courtroom / police arriving at the end
Long-lost twins separated at a fair (Mela)

rounds.title: Round 34
rounds.prompt: Name something that always happens on an Indian family road trip.

answers.text: Packing enough homemade thepla & snacks for 3 days
Dad refusing to stop for bathroom breaks
Leaving 2 hours after the '5:00 AM sharp' plan
Arguing over Google Maps vs. Dad's shortcut
Blasting 90s Bollywood songs the whole drive

answers.text: Eating food / Taking leftovers in Tupperware!

rounds.title: Tie-Breaker 2

answers.text: Kid in Med School / Ivy League (or Tesla in driveway)
